title: At least one communal open space area 50% sunlit for 2 hours, 9am-3pm 21 June
text: There is 50 per cent direct sunlight to at least one communal open space area for a minimum of two hours between 9am and 3pm on 21 June.
notes: landscape.cos.solar_access_pct read as: the highest share of any one COS area that receives at least two hours of direct sunlight between 9am and 3pm on 21 June. verify: the text could mean the same 50% for a continuous two hours.

verified.note: p34 '50 per cent direct sunlight ... for a minimum of two hours' does not say whether the same 50% must be sunlit for two continuous hours.
